# MrW Overlay for POE 2 v2.18.1

## What's new

- **Boxes over the game:** the map loot, Expedition and earnings boxes each have a small `::` grip by their top-right corner. Drag it to move the box; it stays where you let go.

## Fixes

- **Boxes over the game:** placing a box no longer locks up the mouse. With many lines picked, the box's Save button no longer passes the click to the game, and the move pointer no longer stays stuck until the Windows key is pressed.
- **Map loot, inventory scan:**
  - Four-digit stacks (1000 Verisium) are read in full.
  - Exceptional Verisium is counted as such: it shares its picture with variants that are not traded.
  - A cell of an item bigger than one cell is no longer taken for currency (it was read as an essence).
  - In Automatic, frames of the inventory panel still sliding open are skipped, so a map's return no longer lists cells "not read for sure" that were fine.
  - An empty inventory now counts as a map's start, also after clearing the map loot.
  - The inventory is read about three times a second while it is open in the hideout, so the start of the next map is ready sooner.

MrW Overlay is built by a player, for players. It is not an official Grinding Gear Games product, and they don't back it.

## Updating

On v1.8.0 or later, update from Settings → **Updates**. Your filter settings, profiles, saved searches and pathofexile.com connection are kept. The Microsoft Store version updates through the Store.

## Install

The release file is `poe2filtre-windows-amd64.exe`. It is not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may warn you: **More info → Run anyway**. Or get it from the Microsoft Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9PM376D3LFBG
